key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies general service framework and components for operating automated driving buses in public transport networks
Components: ADBs, monitoring and control centre, IoT infrastructure, smart bus stations, passengers
Describes use cases for ADB service operation
Technical Report published June 2024 by ISO/TC 204
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/TR 21734-3:2024, a technical report on performance testing of automated driving buses in public transport. It sets out the service framework, components (buses, monitoring centre, IoT, smart stations, passengers) and use cases for operating automated driving buses.
